package fixture

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	gobuild "go/build"
)

var sharedCache = os.Getenv("GOMODCACHE")

var modcacheArgs = []string{"clean", "-modcache"} // want:go-clean-cache

type rig struct{ cache string }

func runIn(env []string, name string, args ...string) {}

func TestPlanted(t *testing.T) {
	_ = exec.Command("go", "clean", "-modcache").Run() // want:go-clean-cache
	_ = exec.Command("go", "clean", "-cache").Run() // want:go-clean-cache
	_ = exec.Command("go", "clean", "-fuzzcache").Run() // want:go-clean-cache
	_ = exec.Command("sh", "-c", "go clean -i -modcache").Run() // want:go-clean-cache
	runIn(nil, "go", "clean", "-modcache") // want:go-clean-cache
	argv := append([]string{"clean"}, "-cache") // want:go-clean-cache
	_ = argv
	cleanArgs := []string{"clean"}
	cleanArgs = append(cleanArgs, "-modcache")
	_ = exec.Command("go", cleanArgs...).Run() // want:go-clean-cache
	flag := "-fuzzcache"
	cmd := exec.Command("go", "clean", flag) // want:go-clean-cache
	_ = cmd.Run()
	_ = exec.Command("go", modcacheArgs...).Run() // want:go-clean-cache
	base := os.Getenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME")
	goBuild := filepath.Join(base, "go-build")
	_ = os.RemoveAll(goBuild) // want:env-path-delete
	_ = os.RemoveAll(os.Getenv("GOCACHE")) // want:env-path-delete
	home, _ := os.UserHomeDir()
	_ = os.RemoveAll(filepath.Join(home, ".cache")) // want:env-path-delete
	_ = os.RemoveAll(sharedCache) // want:env-path-delete
	out, _ := exec.Command("go", "env", "GOMODCACHE").Output()
	_ = os.RemoveAll(strings.TrimSpace(string(out))) // want:env-path-delete
	envArgs := []string{"env", "GOCACHE"}
	viaVar, _ := exec.Command("go", envArgs...).Output()
	_ = os.RemoveAll(strings.TrimSpace(string(viaVar))) // want:env-path-delete
	_ = os.RemoveAll(cacheDir()) // want:env-path-delete
	removeTree(os.TempDir())
	_ = os.RemoveAll(gobuild.Default.GOPATH) // want:env-path-delete
	_ = exec.Command("rm", "-rf", home).Run() // want:env-path-delete
	_ = exec.Command("sh", "-c", "rm -rf $HOME/.cache/go-build").Run() // want:env-path-delete
	_ = exec.Command("sh", "-c", "rm -rf "+home).Run() // want:env-path-delete
	for _, kv := range os.Environ() {
		if v, ok := strings.CutPrefix(kv, "TMPDIR="); ok {
			_ = os.RemoveAll(v) // want:env-path-delete
		}
	}
	var d rig
	d.cache = os.Getenv("CACHE")
	_ = os.RemoveAll(d.cache) // want:env-path-delete
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_ = os.RemoveAll(home) // want:env-path-delete
	})
}

func cacheDir() string { return filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), ".cache") }

func namedCacheDir() (dir string) {
	dir = os.Getenv("GOCACHE")
	return
}

func TestNamedReturn(t *testing.T) {
	_ = os.RemoveAll(namedCacheDir()) // want:env-path-delete
}

func removeTree(dir string) {
	_ = os.RemoveAll(dir) // want:env-path-delete
}

func TestBooleanSpelling(t *testing.T) {
	_ = exec.Command("go", "clean", "-modcache=true").Run() // want:go-clean-cache
	_ = exec.Command("go", "clean", "--cache=1").Run() // want:go-clean-cache
	_ = exec.Command("go", "clean", "-fuzzcache=T").Run() // want:go-clean-cache
	boolArgs := []string{"clean", "-modcache=TRUE"} // want:go-clean-cache
	_ = exec.Command("go", boolArgs...).Run() // want:go-clean-cache
	_ = exec.Command("sh", "-c", "go clean -testcache -modcache=true").Run() // want:go-clean-cache
	_ = exec.Command("sh", "-c", "go clean -tags x -cache").Run() // want:go-clean-cache
}
